title: The chat route to a design system is kept but turned off by one operator switch (chat-design-system, default off): the agent proposes and applies no design system and points to the Design system button; Use this inspiration is hidden; Help names the button; switched on, the chat applies through the button's own door
steps: S3: node --test test/chat-design-route.test.mjs test/chat-design-route-wiring.test.mjs test/deferred-tools.test.mjs (cwd packages/tools/tracy-site-tools).
expect: S1: switch chat-design-system exists, defaultOn false, group browser-toolbar; switchesAtTracy reads /api/ui at the origin and answers null for no origin, a refusal, a throw or a body without hidden.
S2: offersUseThis is true only with chatRoute on, outside the public page and for a design system; PreviewDialog reads ui.isShown(CHAT_DS_SWITCH); Create with is not conditioned on it.

S3: with chat-design-system hidden, tracy_design_propose and POST /choose answer CHAT_DESIGN_SYSTEM_OFF and design-preview.json is unchanged; tracy_design_library and tracy_design_copy form still answer ok; tracy_site theme.style answers CHAT_DESIGN_SYSTEM_OFF with no /apply call; tracy_design_system apply POSTs /api/sites/<key>/design-system with x-tracy-actor, x-tracy-session and x-tracy-workspace-label; the site context has '- Design systems through the chat: OFF' only when read off, and the line names no deferred tool; tracy_design_system is deferred to the design road.

S4: an apply with an actor grant or x-tracy-session gets 403 CHAT_DESIGN_SYSTEM_OFF with a message naming the Design system button and nothing reaches the host; a cookie press applies; chatRoute true applies from the chat; chatRoute throwing gives 503 UI_SETTING_UNREADABLE.

S5: the Help prompt says to press the Design system button in the toolbar of the site browser, that a new site gets its design at creation, and that the chat route is off; designFact([]) says the chat can apply; with the button hidden it never points at it.

selectors.lane: packages/design/tracy-design-inspiration/src/host/index.ts chatRouteOff; packages/tools/tracy-site-tools/src/host/chat-design-route.mjs, index.ts tracy_design_system / theme.style, site-context.mjs chatRouteLine

evidence: tasks/evidence/ds-button-only-2026-10-11/README.md — the paths found, the results table per flow × CMS, what was measured where (11/10/2026).
fence: Real chat turns on the shared stand are in the evidence, not re-run here: the stand's images do not carry this branch, so the refusal, the context line and the door gate are proven by these tests against the shipped bundles. The /ops press itself (PUT /api/ops/ui) is covered by apps/tracy-web/test/ops-ui.test.mjs (needs Postgres).
